Description: NAICS 333414: Heating Equipment (except Warm Air Furnaces) Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing heating equipment (except electric and warm air furnaces), such as heating boilers, heating stoves, floor and wall furnaces, and wall and baseboard heating units. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333415: Air-Conditioning and Warm Air Heating Equipment and Commercial and Industrial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333415: Air-Conditioning and Warm Air Heating Equipment and Commercial and Industrial Refrigeration Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing air-conditioning (except motor vehicle) and warm air furnace equipment and/or (2) manufacturing commercial and industrial refrigeration and freezer equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333511: Industrial Mold Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333511: Industrial Mold Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial molds for casting metals or forming other materials, such as plastics, glass, or rubber. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333514: Special Die and Tool, Die Set, Jig, and Fixture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333514: Special Die and Tool, Die Set, Jig, and Fixture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments, known as tool and die shops, primarily engaged in manufacturing special tools and fixtures, such as cutting dies and jigs. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333515: Cutting Tool and Machine Tool Accessory Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333515: Cutting Tool and Machine Tool Accessory Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing accessories and attachments for metal cutting and metal forming machine tools. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333517: Machine Tool Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333517: Machine Tool Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing metal cutting machine tools (except handtools) and/or (2) manufacturing metal forming machine tools (except handtools), such as punching, sheering, bending, forming, pressing, forging and die-casting machines. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333519: Rolling Mill and Other Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333519: Rolling Mill and Other Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing rolling mill machinery and equipment and/or other metalworking machinery (except industrial molds; special dies and tools, die sets, jigs, and fixtures; cutting tools and machine tool accessories; and machine tools). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333611: Turbine and Turbine Generator Set Units Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333611: Turbine and Turbine Generator Set Units Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing turbines (except aircraft); and complete turbine generator set units, such as steam, hydraulic, gas, and wind. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333618: Other Engine Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333618: Other Engine Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing internal combustion engines (except automotive gasoline and aircraft). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333912: Air and Gas Compressor Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333912: Air and Gas Compressor Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose air and gas compressors, such as reciprocating compressors, centrifugal compressors, vacuum pumps (except laboratory), and nonagricultural spraying and dusting compressors and spray gun units. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333914: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333914: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing measuring and dispensing pumps, such as gasoline pumps and lubricating oil measuring and dispensing pumps and/or (2) manufacturing general purpose pumps and pumping equipment (except fluid power pumps and motors), such as reciprocating pumps, turbine pumps, centrifugal pumps, rotary pumps, diaphragm pumps, domestic water system pumps, oil well and oil field pumps, and sump pumps. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333922: Conveyor and Conveying Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333922: Conveyor and Conveying Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing conveyors and conveying equipment, such as gravity conveyors, trolley conveyors, tow conveyors, pneumatic tube conveyors, carousel conveyors, farm conveyors, and belt conveyors. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333923: Overhead Traveling Crane, Hoist, and Monorail System Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333923: Overhead Traveling Crane, Hoist, and Monorail System Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing overhead traveling cranes, hoists, and monorail systems. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333924: Industrial Truck, Tractor, Trailer, and Stacker Machinery Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333924: Industrial Truck, Tractor, Trailer, and Stacker Machinery Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial trucks, tractors, trailers, and stackers (i.e., truck-type) such as forklifts, pallet loaders and unloaders, and portable loading docks. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333991: Power-Driven Handtool Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333991: Power-Driven Handtool Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing power-driven (e.g., battery, corded, pneumatic) handtools, such as drills, screwguns, circular saws, chain saws, staplers, and nailers. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333992: Welding and Soldering Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333992: Welding and Soldering Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing welding and soldering equipment and accessories (except transformers), such as arc, resistance, gas, plasma, laser, electron beam, and ultrasonic welding equipment; welding electrodes; coated or cored welding wire; and soldering equipment (except handheld). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333993: Packaging Machinery Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333993: Packaging Machinery Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing packaging machinery, such as wrapping, bottling, canning, and labeling machinery. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333994: Industrial Process Furnace and Oven Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333994: Industrial Process Furnace and Oven Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial process ovens, induction and dielectric heating equipment, and kilns (except cement, chemical, wood). Included in this industry are establishments manufacturing laboratory furnaces and ovens. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333996: Fluid Power Pump and Motor Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333996: Fluid Power Pump and Motor Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing fluid power (i.e., hydraulic and pneumatic) pumps and motors. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 333998: All Other Miscellaneous General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 333998: All Other Miscellaneous General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose machinery (except ventilating, heating, air-conditioning, and commercial refrigeration equipment; metalworking machinery; engines, turbines, and power transmission equipment; pumps and compressors; material handling equipment; power-driven handtools; welding and soldering equipment; packaging machinery; industrial process furnaces and ovens; fluid power cylinders and actuators; and fluid power pumps and motors). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334111: Electronic Computer Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334111: Electronic Computer Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or assembling electronic computers, such as mainframes, personal computers, workstations, laptops, and computer servers. Computers can be analog, digital, or hybrid. Digital computers, the most common type, are devices that do all of the following: (1) store the processing program or programs and the data immediately necessary for the execution of the program; (2) can be freely programmed in accordance with the requirements of the user; (3) perform arithmetical computations specified by the user; and (4) execute, without human intervention, a processing program that requires the computer to modify its execution by logical decision during the processing run. Analog computers are capable of simulating mathematical models and contain at least analog, control, and programming elements. The manufacture of computers includes the assembly or integration of processors, coprocessors, memory, storage, and input/output devices into a user-programmable final product. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334112: Computer Storage Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334112: Computer Storage Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing computer storage devices that allow the storage and retrieval of data from a phase change, magnetic, optical, or magnetic/optical media. Examples of products made by these establishments are computer disk drives, USB flash drives, and tape storage and backup units. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334118: Computer Terminal and Other Computer Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334118: Computer Terminal and Other Computer Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing computer terminals and other computer peripheral equipment (except storage devices). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334210: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334210: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wire telephone and data communications equipment. These products may be stand-alone or board-level components of a larger system. Examples of products made by these establishments are central office switching equipment, cordless and wire telephones (except cellular), PBX equipment, telephone answering machines, LAN modems, multi-user modems, and other data communications equipment, such as bridges, routers, and gateways. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334220: Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334220: Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing radio and television broadcast and wireless communications equipment. Examples of products made by these establishments are transmitting and receiving antennas, cable television equipment, GPS equipment, pagers, cellular phones, mobile communications equipment, and radio and television studio and broadcasting equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334290: Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334290: Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing communications equipment (except telephone apparatus, radio and television broadcast equipment, and wireless communications equipment). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334310: Audio and Video Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334310: Audio and Video Equipment Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic audio and video equipment for home entertainment, motor vehicles, and public address and musical instrument amplification. Examples of products made by these establishments are digital video recorders, televisions, stereo equipment, speaker systems, household-type video cameras, jukeboxes, and amplifiers for musical instruments and public address systems. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334412: Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334412: Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing bare (i.e., rigid or flexible) printed circuit boards without mounted electronic components. These establishments print, perforate, plate, screen, etch, or photoprint interconnecting pathways for electric current on laminates. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334413: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334413: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing semiconductors and related solid-state devices. Examples of products made by these establishments are integrated circuits, memory chips, microprocessors, diodes, transistors, solar cells, and other optoelectronic devices. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334416: Capacitor, Resistor, Coil, Transformer, and Other Inductor Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334416: Capacitor, Resistor, Coil, Transformer, and Other Inductor Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing electronic fixed and variable capacitors and condensers; (2) manufacturing electronic resistors, such as fixed and variable resistors, resistor networks, thermistors, and varistors; and (3) manufacturing electronic inductors, such as coils and transformers. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334417: Electronic Connector Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334417: Electronic Connector Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic connectors, such as coaxial, cylindrical, rack and panel, pin and sleeve, printed circuit, and fiber optic. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334418: Printed Circuit Assembly (Electronic Assembly) Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334418: Printed Circuit Assembly (Electronic Assembly) Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in loading components onto printed circuit boards or who manufacture and ship loaded printed circuit boards. Also known as printed circuit assemblies, electronics assemblies, or modules, these products are printed circuit boards that have some or all of the semiconductor and electronic components inserted or mounted and are inputs to a wide variety of electronic systems and devices. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334419: Other Electronic Component Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334419: Other Electronic Component Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic components (except bare printed circuit boards; semiconductors and related devices; electronic capacitors; electronic resistors; coils, transformers, and other inductors; connectors; and loaded printed circuit boards). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334510: Electromedical and Electrotherapeutic Apparatus Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334510: Electromedical and Electrotherapeutic Apparatus Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electromedical and electrotherapeutic apparatus, such as magnetic resonance imaging equipment, medical ultrasound equipment, pacemakers, hearing aids, electrocardiographs, and electromedical endoscopic equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334511: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334511: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing search, detection, navigation, guidance, aeronautical, and nautical systems and instruments. Examples of products made by these establishments are aircraft instruments (except engine), flight recorders, navigational instruments and systems, radar systems and equipment, and sonar systems and equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334512: Automatic Environmental Control Manufacturing for Residential, Commercial, and Appliance Use
Description: NAICS 334512: Automatic Environmental Control Manufacturing for Residential, Commercial, and Appliance Use. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing automatic controls and regulators for applications, such as heating, air-conditioning, refrigeration, and appliances. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334513: Instruments and Related Products Manufacturing for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables
Description: NAICS 334513: Instruments and Related Products Manufacturing for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing instruments and related devices for measuring, displaying, indicating, recording, transmitting, and controlling industrial process variables. These instruments measure, display, or control (monitor, analyze, and so forth) industrial process variables, such as temperature, humidity, pressure, vacuum, combustion, flow, level, viscosity, density, acidity, concentration, and rotation. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334514: Totalizing Fluid Meter and Counting Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334514: Totalizing Fluid Meter and Counting Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing totalizing (i.e., registering) fluid meters and counting devices. Examples of products made by these establishments are gas consumption meters, water consumption meters, parking meters, taxi meters, motor vehicle gauges, and fare collection equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334515: Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals
Description: NAICS 334515: Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing instruments for measuring and testing the characteristics of electricity and electrical signals. Examples of products made by these establishments are circuit and continuity testers, voltmeters, ohm meters, wattmeters, multimeters, and semiconductor test equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334516: Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334516: Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing instruments and instrumentation systems for laboratory analysis of the chemical or physical composition or concentration of samples of solid, fluid, gaseous, or composite material. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334519: Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 334519: Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing measuring and controlling devices (except search, detection, navigation, guidance, aeronautical, and nautical instruments and systems; automatic environmental controls for residential, commercial, and appliance use; instruments for measurement, display, and control of industrial process variables; totalizing fluid meters and counting devices; instruments for measuring and testing electricity and electrical signals; analytical laboratory instruments; irradiation equipment; and electromedical and electrotherapeutic apparatus). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 334610: Manufacturing and Reproducing Magnetic and Optical Media
Description: NAICS 334610: Manufacturing and Reproducing Magnetic and Optical Media. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing optical and magnetic media, such as blank audio tapes, blank video tapes, and blank diskettes, and/or (2) mass duplicating (i.e., making copies) audio, video, software, and other data on magnetic, optical, and similar media. These establishments do not generally develop software or produce audio or video content. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335131: Residential Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335131: Residential Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing fixed or portable residential electric lighting fixtures and lamp shades of metal, paper, or textiles. Residential electric lighting fixtures include those for use both inside and outside the residence. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335132: Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335132: Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional Electric Lighting Fixture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing commercial, industrial, and institutional electric lighting fixtures. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335139: Electric Lamp Bulb and Other Lighting Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335139: Electric Lamp Bulb and Other Lighting Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric light bulbs, tubes, and parts (except glass blanks for electric light bulbs and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), electric lighting fixtures (except residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and vehicular electric lighting fixtures), and nonelectric lighting equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335210: Small Electrical Appliance Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335210: Small Electrical Appliance Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing small electric appliances and electric housewares, household-type fans (except attic fans), household-type vacuum cleaners, and other electric household-type floor care machines. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335220: Major Household Appliance Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335220: Major Household Appliance Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing household-type cooking appliances, household-type laundry equipment, household-type refrigerators, upright and chest freezers, and other electrical and nonelectrical major household-type appliances, such as dishwashers, water heaters, and garbage disposal units. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335311: Power, Distribution, and Specialty Transformer Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335311: Power, Distribution, and Specialty Transformer Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing power, distribution, and specialty transformers (except electronic components). Industrial-type and consumer-type transformers in this industry vary (e.g., step up or step down) voltage but do not convert alternating to direct or direct to alternating current. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335312: Motor and Generator Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335312: Motor and Generator Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric motors (except internal combustion engine starting motors), power generators (except battery charging alternators for internal combustion engines), and motor generator sets (except turbine generator set units). This industry includes establishments rewinding armatures on a factory basis. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335313: Switchgear and Switchboard Apparatus Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335313: Switchgear and Switchboard Apparatus Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing switchgear and switchboard apparatus. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335314: Relay and Industrial Control Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335314: Relay and Industrial Control Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing relays, motor starters and controllers, and other industrial controls and control accessories. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335910: Battery Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335910: Battery Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing primary and storage batteries. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335921: Fiber Optic Cable Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335921: Fiber Optic Cable Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing insulated fiber optic cable from purchased fiber optic strand. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335929: Other Communication and Energy Wire Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335929: Other Communication and Energy Wire Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing insulated wire and cable of nonferrous metals from purchased wire. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335931: Current-Carrying Wiring Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335931: Current-Carrying Wiring Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing current-carrying wiring devices. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335932: Noncurrent-Carrying Wiring Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335932: Noncurrent-Carrying Wiring Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing noncurrent-carrying wiring devices. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335991: Carbon and Graphite Product Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335991: Carbon and Graphite Product Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing carbon, graphite, and metal-graphite brushes and brush stock; carbon or graphite electrodes for thermal and electrolytic uses; carbon and graphite fibers; and other carbon, graphite, and metal-graphite products. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 335999: All Other Miscellaneous Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 335999: All Other Miscellaneous Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing industrial and commercial electric apparatus and other equipment (except lighting equipment, household appliances, transformers, motors, generators, switchgear, relays, industrial controls, batteries, communication and energy wire and cable, wiring devices, and carbon and graphite products). Examples of products made by these establishments are power converters (i.e., AC to DC and DC to AC), power supplies, surge suppressors, and similar equipment for industrial-type and consumer-type equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336110: Automobile and Light Duty Motor Vehicle Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336110: Automobile and Light Duty Motor Vehicle Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing complete automobiles and light duty motor vehicles (i.e., body and chassis or unibody) or (2) manufacturing automobile and light duty motor vehicle chassis only. Vehicles made include passenger cars, light duty trucks, light duty vans, pick-up trucks, minivans, and sport utility vehicles. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336120: Heavy Duty Truck Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336120: Heavy Duty Truck Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing heavy duty truck chassis and assembling complete heavy duty trucks, buses, heavy duty motor homes, and other special purpose heavy duty motor vehicles for highway use or (2) manufacturing heavy duty truck chassis only. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336211: Motor Vehicle Body Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336211: Motor Vehicle Body Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing truck and bus bodies and cabs and automobile bodies. The products made may be sold separately or may be assembled on purchased chassis and sold as complete vehicles. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336212: Truck Trailer Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336212: Truck Trailer Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing truck trailers, truck trailer chassis, cargo container chassis, detachable trailer bodies, and detachable trailer chassis for sale separately. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336214: Travel Trailer and Camper Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336214: Travel Trailer and Camper Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing travel trailers and campers designed to attach to motor vehicles; (2) manufacturing pick-up coaches (i.e., campers) and caps (i.e., covers) for mounting on pick-up trucks; and (3) manufacturing automobile, utility, and light-truck trailers. Travel trailers do not have their own motor but are designed to be towed by a motor unit, such as an automobile or a light truck. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336310: Motor Vehicle Gasoline Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336310: Motor Vehicle Gasoline Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle gasoline engines and engine parts and/or (2) manufacturing and/or rebuilding carburetors, pistons, piston rings, and engine valves, whether or not for vehicular use. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336320: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336320: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding electrical and electronic equipment for motor vehicles and internal combustion engines. The products made can be used for all types of transportation equipment (i.e., aircraft, automobiles, trucks, trains, ships) or stationary internal combustion engine applications. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336330: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336330: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle steering mechanisms and suspension components (except springs). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336340: Motor Vehicle Brake System Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336340: Motor Vehicle Brake System Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle brake systems and related components. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336350: Motor Vehicle Transmission and Power Train Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336350: Motor Vehicle Transmission and Power Train Parts Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle transmissions and power train parts. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336360: Motor Vehicle Seating and Interior Trim Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336360: Motor Vehicle Seating and Interior Trim Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motor vehicle seating, seats, seat frames, seat belts, and interior trimmings. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336370: Motor Vehicle Metal Stamping
Description: NAICS 336370: Motor Vehicle Metal Stamping. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motor vehicle stampings, such as fenders, tops, body parts, trim, and molding. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336390: Other Motor Vehicle Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336390: Other Motor Vehicle Parts Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle parts and accessories (except motor vehicle gasoline engines and engine parts, motor vehicle electrical and electronic equipment, motor vehicle steering and suspension components, motor vehicle brake systems, motor vehicle transmissions and power train parts, motor vehicle seating and interior trim, and motor vehicle stampings). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336411: Aircraft Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336411: Aircraft Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing or assembling complete aircraft; (2) developing and making aircraft prototypes; (3) aircraft conversion (i.e., major modifications to systems); and (4) complete aircraft overhaul and rebuilding (i.e., periodic restoration of aircraft to original design specifications). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336412: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336412: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing aircraft engines and engine parts; (2) developing and making prototypes of aircraft engines and engine parts; (3) aircraft propulsion system conversion (i.e., major modifications to systems); and (4) aircraft propulsion systems overhaul and rebuilding (i.e., periodic restoration of aircraft propulsion system to original design specifications). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336413: Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336413: Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing aircraft parts or auxiliary equipment (except engines and aircraft fluid power subassemblies) and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of aircraft parts and auxiliary equipment. Auxiliary equipment includes such items as crop dusting apparatus, armament racks, inflight refueling equipment, and external fuel tanks. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336414: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336414: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing complete guided missiles and space vehicles and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missiles or space vehicles. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336415: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336415: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing guided missile and/or space vehicle propulsion units and propulsion unit parts and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missile and space vehicle propulsion units and propulsion unit parts. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336419: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336419: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment (except guided missile and space vehicle propulsion units and propulsion unit parts) and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336510: Railroad Rolling Stock Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336510: Railroad Rolling Stock Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing and/or rebuilding locomotives, locomotive frames, and parts; (2) manufacturing railroad, street, and rapid transit cars and car equipment for operation on rails for freight and passenger service; and (3) manufacturing rail layers, ballast distributors, rail tamping equipment, and other railway track maintenance equipment. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336611: Ship Building and Repairing
Description: NAICS 336611: Ship Building and Repairing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating shipyards. Shipyards are fixed facilities with drydocks and fabrication equipment capable of building a ship, defined as watercraft typically suitable or intended for other than personal or recreational use. Activities of shipyards include the construction of ships, their repair, conversion and alteration, the production of prefabricated ship and barge sections, and specialized services, such as ship scaling. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336612: Boat Building
Description: NAICS 336612: Boat Building. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building boats. Boats are defined as watercraft not built in shipyards and typically of the type suitable or intended for personal use. Included in this industry are establishments that manufacture heavy-duty inflatable rubber or inflatable plastic boats (RIBs). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336991: Motorcycle, Bicycle, and Parts Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336991: Motorcycle, Bicycle, and Parts Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motorcycles, bicycles, tricycles and similar equipment, and parts. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336992: Military Armored Vehicle, Tank, and Tank Component Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336992: Military Armored Vehicle, Tank, and Tank Component Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing complete military armored vehicles, combat tanks, specialized components for combat tanks, and self-propelled weapons. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 336999: All Other Transportation Equipment Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 336999: All Other Transportation Equipment Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing transportation equipment (except motor vehicles, motor vehicle parts, boats, ships, railroad rolling stock, aerospace products, motorcycles, bicycles, armored vehicles, and tanks). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337110: Wood Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337110: Wood Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood or plastics laminated on wood kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and countertops (except freestanding). The cabinets and counters may be made on a stock or custom basis. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337121: Upholstered Household Furniture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337121: Upholstered Household Furniture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing upholstered household-type furniture. The furniture may be made on a stock or custom basis. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337122: Nonupholstered Wood Household Furniture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337122: Nonupholstered Wood Household Furniture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonupholstered wood household-type furniture and freestanding cabinets (except television, stereo, and sewing machine cabinets). The furniture may be made on a stock or custom basis and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337126: Household Furniture (except Wood and Upholstered) Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337126: Household Furniture (except Wood and Upholstered) Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonupholstered household-type furniture of materials other than wood, such as metal, plastics, reed, rattan, wicker, and fiberglass. The furniture may be partially upholstered (e.g., chairs with upholstered seats or backs), made on a stock or custom basis, and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337127: Institutional Furniture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337127: Institutional Furniture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing institutional-type furniture (e.g., library, school, theater, and church furniture). Included in this industry are establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose hospital, laboratory, and dental furniture (e.g., tables, stools, and benches). The furniture may be made on a stock or custom basis and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337211: Wood Office Furniture Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337211: Wood Office Furniture Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood office-type furniture. The furniture may be made on a stock or custom basis and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337212: Custom Architectural Woodwork and Millwork Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337212: Custom Architectural Woodwork and Millwork Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing custom designed interiors consisting of architectural woodwork and fixtures utilizing wood, wood products, and plastics laminates. All of the industry output is made to individual order on a job shop basis and requires skilled craftsmen as a labor input. A job might include custom manufacturing of display fixtures, gondolas, wall shelving units, entrance and window architectural detail, sales and reception counters, wall paneling, and matching furniture. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337214: Office Furniture (except Wood) Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337214: Office Furniture (except Wood) Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonwood office-type furniture. The furniture may be made on a stock or custom basis and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337215: Showcase, Partition, Shelving, and Locker Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337215: Showcase, Partition, Shelving, and Locker Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wood and nonwood office and store fixtures, shelving, lockers, frames, partitions, and related fabricated products of wood and nonwood materials, including plastics laminated fixture tops. The products are made on a stock or custom basis and may be assembled or unassembled (i.e., knockdown). Establishments exclusively making furniture parts (e.g., frames) are included in this industry. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337910: Mattress Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337910: Mattress Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing innerspring, box spring, and noninnerspring mattresses. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 337920: Blind and Shade Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 337920: Blind and Shade Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing one or more of the following: venetian blinds, other window blinds, and shades; curtain and drapery rods and poles; and/or curtain and drapery fixtures. The blinds and shades may be made on a stock or custom basis and may be made of any material. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339112: Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339112: Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing medical, surgical, ophthalmic, and veterinary instruments and apparatus (except electrotherapeutic, electromedical, and irradiation apparatus). Examples of products made by these establishments are syringes, hypodermic needles, anesthesia apparatus, blood transfusion equipment, catheters, surgical clamps, and medical thermometers. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339113: Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339113: Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing surgical appliances and supplies. Examples of products made by these establishments are orthopedic devices, prosthetic appliances, surgical dressings, crutches, surgical sutures, personal industrial safety devices (except protective eyewear), hospital beds, and operating room tables. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339114: Dental Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339114: Dental Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing dental equipment and supplies used by dental laboratories and offices of dentists, such as dental chairs, dental instrument delivery systems, dental hand instruments, dental impression material, and dental cements. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339115: Ophthalmic Goods Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339115: Ophthalmic Goods Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing ophthalmic goods. Examples of products made by these establishments are prescription eyeglasses (except grinding lenses in a retail setting), contact lenses, sunglasses, eyeglass frames, reading glasses made to standard powers, and protective eyewear. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339116: Dental Laboratories
Description: NAICS 339116: Dental Laboratories. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing dentures, crowns, bridges, and orthodontic appliances customized for individual application. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339910: Jewelry and Silverware Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339910: Jewelry and Silverware Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching fine and costume jewelry; (2) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching metal personal goods (i.e., small articles carried on or about the person, such as compacts or cigarette cases); (3) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching precious metal solid, precious metal clad, or pewter flatware and other hollowware; (4) stamping coins; (5) manufacturing unassembled jewelry parts and stock shop products, such as sheet, wire, and tubing; (6) cutting, slabbing, tumbling, carving, engraving, polishing, or faceting precious or semiprecious stones and gems; (7) recutting, repolishing, and setting gem stones; and (8) drilling, sawing, and peeling cultured and costume pearls. This industry includes establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing precious solid, precious clad, and precious plated jewelry and personal goods. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339920: Sporting and Athletic Goods Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339920: Sporting and Athletic Goods Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing sporting and athletic goods (except apparel and footwear). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339930: Doll, Toy, and Game Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339930: Doll, Toy, and Game Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing complete dolls, doll parts, doll clothes, action figures, toys, games (including electronic, such as gaming consoles and devices and handheld video games), hobby kits, and children's vehicles (except metal bicycles and tricycles). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339940: Office Supplies (except Paper) Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339940: Office Supplies (except Paper) Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing office supplies. Examples of products made by these establishments are pens, pencils, felt tip markers, crayons, chalk, pencil sharpeners, staplers, modeling clay, hand operated stamps, stamp pads, stencils, carbon paper, and inked ribbons. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339950: Sign Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339950: Sign Manufacturing. This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing signs and related displays of all materials (except printing paper and paperboard signs, notices, displays). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339991: Gasket, Packing, and Sealing Device Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339991: Gasket, Packing, and Sealing Device Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing gaskets, packing, and sealing devices of all materials. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339992: Musical Instrument Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339992: Musical Instrument Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing musical instruments (except toys). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339994: Broom, Brush, and Mop Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339994: Broom, Brush, and Mop Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing brooms, mops, and brushes. (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339995: Burial Casket Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339995: Burial Casket Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing burial caskets, cases, and vaults (except concrete). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: NAICS 339999: All Other Miscellaneous Manufacturing
Description: NAICS 339999: All Other Miscellaneous Manufacturing. This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in miscellaneous manufacturing (except medical equipment and supplies, jewelry and silverware, sporting and athletic goods, dolls, toys, games, office supplies, signs, gaskets, packing, and sealing devices, musical instruments, fasteners, buttons, needles, pins, brooms, brushes, mops, and burial caskets). (source: U.S. Census Bureau, NAICS 2022)

Label: Nickel Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of nickel is electrochemically deposited onto a metal surface to enhance corrosion resistance and wear properties. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Nitriding
Description: A process that involves diffusing nitrogen into the surface of a metal to create a hard, wear-resistant layer. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Notching
Description: A process that involves cutting angular or V-shaped indentations along the edge or surface of a workpiece, typically using a press. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Oil Grooving
Description: A process where specific channels are cut into components to facilitate the distribution and retention of lubricating oil. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Oil Quench Hardening
Description: A process where steel is heated to a specific temperature, then rapidly cooled in oil to increase hardness and toughness. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Open Die Forging
Description: A process where a workpiece is deformed between a set of open dies that do not enclose the material entirely, allowing metal flow. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Ownership Status Classifier
Description: An ownership status of a manufacturer, such as minority-owned or veteran-owned. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Packing
Description: A process where finished products are securely enclosed in containers or packaging materials for protection, storage, and transportation. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Passivation
Description: A process that involves treating or coating a metal to reduce the chemical reactivity of its surface, enhancing its corrosion resistance. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Percussion Welding
Description: A process where rapid, controlled energy pulses create high-intensity impacts to fuse materials together without the need for filler metals or fluxes. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Permanent Mold Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is poured into a reusable mold, cooled, and solidified to form a part, known as permanent mold casting. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Phosphate Coating
Description: A process where metal surfaces are treated with a solution of phosphoric acid and phosphates to form a protective, corrosion-resistant layer. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Phosphate Conversion Coating
Description: A process where a metal surface is treated with a phosphate solution to form a layer of insoluble crystalline phosphates for corrosion resistance and paint adhesion. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Physical Vapor Deposition
Description: A process where material is vaporized from a solid source and condensed onto a substrate, forming a thin film, in a vacuum environment. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Planarization
Description: A process that involves flattening and smoothing a surface to achieve a uniform, level plane in semiconductor manufacturing. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Planing
Description: A process that involves shaving off layers from a material's surface to achieve a smooth, flat finish using a planing machine. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plasma Arc Welding
Description: A process where a constricted plasma arc melts the workpiece and filler material, creating a joint upon solidification. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plasma Cutting
Description: A process where an accelerated jet of hot plasma cuts through electrically conductive materials, utilizing high-speed, precision-guided technology. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plasma Spraying
Description: A process where a high-temperature plasma jet melts particles, which are then sprayed onto a substrate to form a coating. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plaster Mold Casting
Description: A process where a plaster mixture is used to create a mold for casting non-ferrous materials, typically involving a two-part mold system. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plastic Machining
Description: A process where solid blocks of plastic are precisely cut, drilled, or shaped using specialized tools or CNC machines to create specific components. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of metal is deposited onto the surface of a workpiece to enhance corrosion resistance, wear resistance, or aesthetics. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Plunge Grinding
Description: A process where a workpiece is ground by a grinding wheel, moving axially into the workpiece to remove material. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Polishing
Description: A process that involves abrading materials to a smooth, reflective surface, reducing surface roughness and removing surface defects. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Polycrystalline Diamond Machining
Description: A process where a polycrystalline diamond, a high-performance cutting tool material, is used to machine extremely hard and abrasive materials. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Polymer Deposition
Description: The process of creating a layer of polymer material on a substrate. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Postal Address
Description: A postal address node; its text is read through hasTextValue. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Powder Coating
Description: A process where dry, free-flowing thermoplastic or thermoset powder material is applied to a surface, then cured under heat to form a solid coating. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Powder Deposition
Description: The process where materials are added in powder form to a molten pool created by a high-energy source, typically a laser or electron beam. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Powder Metal Forming
Description: A process where metallic powders are compacted under high pressure and heated to form solid metal parts through sintering. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Press Fitting
Description: A process where components are joined by being pressed into each other under high pressure, creating a tight, secure connection without welding or adhesives. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Press Forging
Description: A process where metal is heated and shaped under high pressure using a press, resulting in high-strength, durable components. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Pressure Welding
Description: A process where metals are joined under high pressure and elevated temperature, causing coalescence without the need for a filler material. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Process Annealing
Description: A process where metals are heated below their recrystallization temperature, then cooled to reduce hardness and increase ductility for further processing. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Projection Welding
Description: A process where two metal pieces are joined by applying heat and pressure, generated by electric current, through a shaped electrode. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Punching
Description: A process where a punch press applies high force to a tool or die, creating holes in a workpiece by removing material. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Ram EDM
Description: A process that utilizes electrical discharges to remove material from a workpiece, specifically through a series of rapidly recurring current discharges. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Reaction Injection Molding
Description: A process where two liquid components are mixed and injected into a mold to chemically react and form a thermosetting polymer. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Reaming
Description: A process that involves enlarging pre-drilled holes to precise dimensions using a multi-edged fluted cutting tool known as a reamer. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Recovery Annealing
Description: A process where heat treatment is applied to cold-worked metal to restore its ductility and reduce its hardness and internal stresses. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Resin Transfer Molding
Description: A process where a fiber preform is placed into a mold, and then liquid resin is injected to impregnate the fibers and harden into shape. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Resistance Brazing
Description: A process where heat is generated through electrical resistance to join metal pieces using a filler metal, without melting the base materials. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Resistance Soldering
Description: A process where heat generated from electrical resistance is used to melt solder, creating a robust joint between two metal pieces. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Riveting
Description: A process where two or more materials are joined together using a rivet, a non-removable mechanical fastener, to create a strong, permanent assembly. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Roll Die Engraving
Description: A process where a hardened image is engraved onto a roll die to imprint patterns or designs onto a material during production. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Roll Forging
Description: A process that involves continuously hammering a long, heated metal piece between two cylindrical or semi-cylindrical rolls to reduce its thickness. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Roll Forming
Description: A process where metal strips are continuously bent into a specified cross-sectional profile through a series of roll stands. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Rolling
Description: A process that reduces the thickness of a long workpiece by compressive forces applied through a set of rolls. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Rotary Broaching
Description: A process where a specially designed tool is rotated and pressed into a workpiece to cut complex shapes like hexagonal or square holes. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Rotational Molding
Description: A process where a heated hollow mold is filled with a material and then slowly rotated, causing the softened material to disperse and stick to the walls. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Rubber Injection Molding
Description: A process where heated rubber is injected into a mold under high pressure to produce precise, high-volume rubber parts. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Sand Blasting
Description: A process where high-speed streams of sand particles are propelled towards a surface to clean or etch it. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Sand Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is poured into a sand mold to form complex metal parts through solidification. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Sawing
Description: A process where materials such as wood or metal are cut into specific dimensions using a tool with a hard, serrated edge, known as a saw. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Seam Welding
Description: A process where two metal sheets are joined by continuously creating a weld along their touching edges using heat and pressure. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Selective Laser Melting
Description: The process is where a high-powered laser selectively melts and fuses metal powder, layer by layer, to create solid 3D parts. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Selective Laser Sintering
Description: The process that uses a laser to selectively fuse powdered materials, layer by layer, to create a solid object (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Selective Mask Sintering
Description: The process uses IR light and a digitally printed optical mask to sinter or melt layers of plastic powder selectively. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Semiconductor Fabricating
Description: A process where integrated circuits are produced on semiconductor materials, involving photolithography, etching, doping, and metallization. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shaping
Description: A process where raw materials are manipulated, through methods such as cutting or forming, to create specific geometrical configurations. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shearing
Description: A process where a machine or tool applies a large cutting force to a material, causing it to break along a straight line without forming chips or using heat. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shell Molding
Description: A process where resin-coated sand is heated and formed into a mold, which is then filled with molten metal to create precise castings. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shielded Metal Arc Welding
Description: A process where an electric current is used to join metals together using a flux-coated electrode, creating a shielded gas environment. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shot Peening
Description: A process where small spherical shot is blasted against a surface to induce compressive residual stresses, enhancing fatigue strength and reducing metal failure. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Shrink Fitting
Description: A process where components are heated or cooled to alter their dimensions for interference fit assembly, exploiting thermal expansion or contraction. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Silver Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of silver is electrochemically deposited onto a conductive surface to enhance conductivity, reflectivity, and corrosion resistance. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Sinker EDM
Description: A process where electrical discharges are used to machine complex cavities in hardened steel by utilizing a graphite or copper electrode. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Sintering
Description: A process where powdered material is heated to a temperature below its melting point to form a solid mass through atomic diffusion. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Slab Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool removes material from a workpiece in a direction perpendicular to its axis, producing a flat surface. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Slitting
Description: A process where a coil of material is cut longitudinally into narrower strips using sharp rotary blades. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Small Hole Drilling
Description: A process where precise, miniature holes are created in a material using specialized drilling machines or laser technology. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Soldering
Description: A process where two or more metal items are joined together by melting and flowing a filler metal into the joint. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Solid Deposition
Description: The process where a substance changes directly from a gas (or vapor) phase into a solid phase, bypassing the liquid state. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Spark Plasma Sintering
Description: A process where rapid, pulsed direct current creates heat, facilitating the consolidation and synthesis of powders into solid materials via sintering. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Specialized Machining
Description: A process where specific, advanced machinery is utilized to create intricate parts with high precision and accuracy. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Spinning
Description: A process where fibers are drawn out and twisted together to create yarn or thread, typically using a spinning wheel or industrial machinery. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Spot Welding
Description: A process where two metal surfaces are joined by applying heat and pressure, generated from an electrical current, at specific points. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Square Tubing
Description: A process where flat, strip steel is formed, welded, and cut into specific lengths to produce hollow, square-shaped tubes. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Squeeze Casting
Description: A process where molten metal is forced into a preheated die under high pressure, solidifying under pressure to produce a dense, high-strength casting. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Stamping
Description: A process where a flat sheet metal is shaped by a die through pressing, punching, or bending operations under high pressure. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: State
Description: A state or province that cities are located in. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Stereolithography
Description: The process uses a liquid photopolymer resin, also known as resin, which is cured layer by layer using a UV laser or light source. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Stress Relieving
Description: A process where residual stresses in a material are reduced or eliminated through heating, holding, and cooling operations. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Stretch Blow Molding
Description: A process where preheated plastic parisons are inflated to form a hollow product using high-pressure air in a mold. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Stretch Forming
Description: A process where a metal piece is stretched and bent simultaneously over a die to create contoured parts. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Stud Welding
Description: A process where a metal stud is joined to a workpiece through heat generated from electrical resistance, creating a high-quality, load-bearing weld. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Submerged Arc Welding
Description: A process where coalescence is produced by heating with an arc between a bare metal electrode and the workpiece, under a blanket of granular flux. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Surface Finishing
Description: A process where material surfaces are altered to obtain specific properties, such as smoothness, glossiness, or roughness, through techniques like polishing, buffing, or sanding. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Surface Hardening
Description: A process that involves altering the properties of the surface layer of a metal to enhance its hardness and resistance to wear and fatigue. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Surface Preparation
Description: A process where the surface of a material is cleaned, treated, or modified to enhance adhesion, corrosion resistance, or paint application. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Swagging
Description: A process that involves reducing the diameter of an object by forcing it through a die or forming it around a mandrel. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Swiss Machining
Description: A process where precision parts are produced by guiding a rotating workpiece through a fixed, programmatically controlled cutting tool, known as Swiss machining. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: TIG Welding
Description: A process where an electric arc forms between a non-consumable tungsten electrode and the workpiece, creating high-quality, precise welds. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tapping
Description: A process where internal threads are cut into a pre-drilled hole using a specific tool known as a tap. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tempering
Description: A process where heat-treated steel or metal is reheated to a lower temperature to increase toughness and reduce brittleness. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Textile Process
Description: A process where raw materials are transformed into finished textile products through spinning, weaving, knitting, dyeing, and printing. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Joining
Description: A process where materials are joined through the application of heat, causing fusion or coalescence, without significant deformation of the components. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Coating
Description: A process where materials are coated with a thermal spray to enhance surface properties such as resistance to wear, heat, or corrosion. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Deburring
Description: A process where excess material on workpieces is removed through controlled thermal energy, resulting in smooth, burr-free surfaces. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Spray Coating
Description: A process where a coating material is heated and sprayed onto a surface to improve corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and thermal insulation. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Subtraction
Description: A process where heat is applied to remove material layers, altering the physical properties and dimensions of the workpiece. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermal Welding
Description: A process where heat is applied to join materials, typically metals or thermoplastics, by melting the parts and adding a filler material to form a weld pool. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thermoforming
Description: A process where a plastic sheet is heated to a pliable forming temperature, formed to a specific shape in a mold, and trimmed to create a usable product. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thin Wall Machining
Description: A process that involves the removal of material from a workpiece to create components with thin walls using precise CNC machining techniques. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Thread Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool, the thread mill, is used to produce threads in a workpiece, typically via CNC machining. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Threading
Description: A process that involves creating helical grooves in a cylindrical surface or hole, typically using a tap or die. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Through Hardening
Description: A process that involves heating a steel part above its critical temperature, then rapidly cooling it, to increase hardness throughout the entire piece. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tin Plating
Description: A process where a thin layer of tin is electrochemically deposited onto a metal substrate to enhance corrosion resistance, solderability, and aesthetic appeal. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tool Making
Description: A process that involves designing, creating, and maintaining specialized tools used in manufacturing and production operations. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Torch Brazing
Description: A process where a torch is used to melt filler metal, creating a joint between two base materials without melting them. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Torch Cutting
Description: A process where a high-temperature flame, typically from an oxy-fuel torch, is used to sever, trim, or pierce metal materials. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Transfer Molding
Description: A process where pre-measured material is heated and pressurized into a mold cavity, solidifying to form a part upon cooling. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tube Bending
Description: A process that involves deforming metal tubes into specific angles and radii using dedicated machinery and tooling. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tube Drawing
Description: A process where a tube is reduced in diameter and/or wall thickness by pulling it through a die, enhancing its mechanical properties. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tubing
Description: Tubing is a manufacturing operation used to create hollow cylindrical structures (tubes) with controlled dimensions and mechanical properties, typically from metal, plastic, or composite materials. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Tumbling
Description: A process that involves smoothing and polishing a rough surface by continuously turning it in a machine filled with abrasive substances. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Turning
Description: A process that involves rotating a workpiece while a single-point cutting tool removes material, resulting in a cylindrical shape. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Two Dimensional Cartesian Spatial Coordinate Datum
Description: A coordinate node carrying a latitude and a longitude value, as strings. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: US Postal Code
Description: A ZIP code node; its value is read through hasIntegerValue, as a string. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Ultrasonic Cleaning
Description: A process where high-frequency sound waves create cavitation bubbles in a liquid to remove contaminants from solid surfaces. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Ultrasonic Welding
Description: A process that utilizes high-frequency ultrasonic acoustic vibrations to create solid-state welds between materials, typically plastics or lightweight metals. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Upset Forging
Description: A process where metal is heated and compressed under high pressure at one end to increase its diameter, known as upset forging. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Assisted Resin Transfer Molding
Description: A process where resin is drawn into a sealed mold containing a dry fiber preform using vacuum pressure, ensuring complete saturation and void-free laminates. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Brazing
Description: A process where metals are joined at high temperatures in a vacuum environment to prevent oxidation and maintain material properties. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Casting
Description: A process where a vacuum is used to draw liquid material into a mold, ensuring precise replication of the mold's shape and details. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Forming
Description: A process where a heated thermoplastic sheet is shaped over a mold by applying vacuum pressure, creating detailed, uniform components. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Hardening
Description: A process where materials are heated in a vacuum environment and rapidly cooled to increase hardness and mechanical strength. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Molding
Description: A process where a sheet of plastic is heated to a forming temperature, stretched onto a single-surface mold, and forced against the mold by a vacuum. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Packaging
Description: A process where products are enclosed in airtight packaging under vacuum conditions to prevent oxidation, spoilage, and extend shelf life. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Pressing
Description: A process where materials are compressed and bonded under vacuum pressure, typically using heat and adhesive to form laminated or veneered products. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vacuum Thermoforming
Description: A process where a plastic sheet is heated to a pliable forming temperature, then shaped by a mold under vacuum pressure. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vaporized Metal Coating
Description: A process where a metal is vaporized and condensed onto a substrate, forming a thin, uniform coating for enhanced surface properties. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vertical Boring
Description: A process where a rotating tool bores holes in a workpiece vertically, utilizing a vertical lathe or vertical boring mill. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vertical Milling
Description: A process where a rotating cutting tool removes material from a workpiece in a vertically oriented spindle in a milling machine. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Vibratory Deburring
Description: A process where high-frequency vibrations are used to remove burrs and imperfections from manufactured metal parts. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Water Quench Hardening
Description: A process where heated metal parts are rapidly cooled in water, increasing hardness and strength through the formation of martensite. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Waterjet Cutting
Description: A process where high-pressure water, often mixed with abrasives, is used to cut through materials with precision and without heat-induced distortion. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wave Soldering
Description: A process where electronic components are soldered onto a PCB using a molten solder wave, ensuring efficient and uniform connections. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Weaving
Description: A process that interlaces two sets of yarns at right angles to generate a fabric or textile, typically executed on a loom. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Web Address
Description: A web address of a manufacturer; the URL is its rdfs:label. Part of the SUDOKN manufacturer data embedded in this graph.

Label: Wet Painting
Description: A process where a liquid paint is applied to a surface and cured, providing a protective or decorative layer on the manufactured product. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wire Bending
Description: A process where a machine or tool precisely deforms a wire into specific geometric configurations based on predefined specifications. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wire Drawing
Description: A process where a metal wire is reduced in diameter by pulling it through a series of dies under tension. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wire EDM
Description: A process that utilizes electrical discharges to cut intricate shapes or profiles into hard conductive materials with high precision. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wire Harness Assembly
Description: A process where individual wires, cables, and subassemblies are arranged, bound together, and fitted with connectors to form a wire harness. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Wood Working
Description: A process that involves cutting, shaping, and assembling wood to construct products such as furniture, cabinetry, and sculptures. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Zero Stock Machining
Description: A process where parts are produced on-demand, directly from raw materials, eliminating the need for inventory storage. (source: sudokn KG)

Label: Zinc Plating
Description: A process where a layer of zinc is electrochemically applied to a metal surface to provide corrosion resistance and enhance aesthetic appeal. (source: sudokn KG)
